newsitem.title: USA: IBM jumps at open, some profit-taking seen.
newsitem.headline: IBM jumps at open, some profit-taking seen.

text.p: Shares in International Business Machines Corp. leaped $12.125 to $154.50 Thursday in response to its favorable earnings report.

The stock jumped in response to its better-than-expected earnings per share of $2.37 a share, which was well above the consensus Wall Street estimate for $2.28 a share. IBM reported its first quarter results after the close of trading Wednesday.
